description: Adjusted risk ratios by speeding type under model A and model B for fatal and fatal-or-serious (KA) crashes, with 95% and 90% intervals and the symmetric equivalence bound implied by the 90% interval
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with known maximum severity
method: Model A (published) and model B (A + crash type + vehicles) with the speeding indicator replaced by speeding type; standardised margins; linearised CIs (t, 42 df); the 90% interval gives two one-sided 5% tests
